einzeiler: Discussing recent Bravo news, reality TV drama, and the latest episodes with Recap Rodeo.

They discuss recent reunions and cast drama, including serious legal news surrounding several well-known reality stars. The conversation also covers the lighthearted moments from ultimate trips and the dynamics on newer shows.

beschreibung:
This week Mandy is joined by hilarious Recap Rodeo duo Lyndsay and Brady. They start out by discussing some of the latest Bravo news stories (trigger warning: domestic violence and sexual assault) but then get into the two best shows on Bravo right now: RHUGT and Next Gen NYC. Plus, hear Mandy’s thoughts on the amazing RHOA reunion and underwhelming 20th season of RHOC.
